prompt: 我们 webapp 里接了一批 MCP 服务器，想知道它们和功能模块怎么连的。请用 onepager 把它们展示给我——用 SVG 画出来：每个 MCP 一个节点，标注名称、类型和用途；MCP 节点用箭头连到它服务的功能模块节点。页面开头先给一句总结论。
assertions: Output is a single self-contained HTML file with zero external script/link/img resources
An inline SVG renders each MCP as a labeled node carrying name, type, and purpose
SVG arrow edges connect MCP nodes to webapp feature-module nodes
The page leads with a verdict-first summary line before the diagram
